* Alternate spliterator for stream of generators of type * SplittableGenerator. We multiplex the two versions into one class by * treating "infinite" as equivalent to Long.MAX_VALUE. For splits, it * uses the standard divide-by-two approach. * *

This differs from * {@link AbstractSplittableGenerator.RandomSplitsSpliterator} in that it * provides a brine argument (a mixture of salt and an index) when * calling the {@link SplittableGenerator#split() split}() method.
